residuals.originalTitle: GS-01 — HIGH — Shared host and administrator trust
residuals.originalDefinition:
The documented boundary and requirement for explicit host/operator trust assumptions
are accepted for design/reference only. Resistance to compromise of a shared host,
hypervisor or privileged administrator is not accepted. Before authorizing dependent
implementation, require the relevant host/operator capability model, selected topology
and independently applicable Security controls. Container boundaries alone do not prove
host-level security. Unresolved technical requirements remain binding.
residuals.currentDocumentedStatus: ACCEPTED FOR LIMITED DESIGN SCOPE — RUNTIME HOST/ADMIN ISOLATION NOT ACCEPTED
residuals.applicableEvidenceBoundary: Non-superuser roles, runtime capability/container restrictions, network boundaries and owned-resource cleanup under trusted host/driver administration.
residuals.remainingGap: No demonstration of resistance to compromise of a real shared host, hypervisor, Docker daemon or privileged administrator; runtime role denial does not contain a true PostgreSQL superuser.
requiredDependency: Approved host/operator capability and threat model for the selected profile/topology
Independently applicable host/network/security controls and implementation authorization before dependent reliance
residuals.ownerEvidence: No accountable GS-01 residual-owner assignment was located in the authoritative definitions or reviewed predecessor inventory. Proposed platform/security OD owners are not an appointment for this residual.
residuals.impactOnRuntimeAcceptance: Host/admin isolation and residual-risk treatment cannot be inferred from laboratory container isolation; final runtime acceptance remains PENDING.
requiredClosureEvidence: Traceable approved profile-specific host/operator capability model and topology
Evidence for applicable isolation/administrative controls against the approved threat assumptions, including explicit exclusions
Accountable ownership and independent review/disposition linked to the exact deployed profile and evidence revision
residuals.requiredAuthorityDecision: Applicable architecture/security authority must determine scope and controls; final runtime evidence sufficiency and acceptance remain exclusively independent TAO/authority. No risk acceptance or closure is issued here.
residuals.reviewDisposition: PRESERVED — NO CLOSURE, DOWNGRADE, WAIVER OR REDEFINITION

residuals.originalDefinition:
Design/CI policy documentation does not prove effective hosted enforcement. Satisfy
applicable supply-chain prerequisites before authorizing implementation that relies on
them. Before the relevant merge, promotion, deployment or release, require applicable
hosted protection, artifact/image provenance, verified digest binding and vulnerability
policy enforcement evidence. JAR attestation is not Managed container-image assurance.
No production supply-chain acceptance is issued. `OWNER ASSIGNMENT REQUIRED`: an
accountable owner must be assigned before the dependent milestone.
residuals.currentDocumentedStatus: FUTURE ENFORCEMENT OBLIGATION PRESERVED — MANAGED PROMOTION EXCLUDED
residuals.applicableEvidenceBoundary: Existing pinned local Java/PostgreSQL/JDBC inputs, source integrity, tool-image identities and recorded containment/cleanup support laboratory provenance/repeatability only; the operational case IDs are package locators, not supply-chain conformance tests.
residuals.remainingGap: No production hosted-protection enforcement, complete image/artifact publisher provenance, vulnerability-policy enforcement or accountable GS-04 owner assignment is established by these probes.
requiredDependency: Accountable owner assignment before the dependent milestone
Applicable hosted protection, provenance, digest-to-artifact binding and vulnerability-policy evidence before dependent merge/promotion/deployment/release
Scope-specific supply-chain prerequisites before authorizing implementation that relies on them
residuals.ownerEvidence: The authoritative definition explicitly says OWNER ASSIGNMENT REQUIRED. No subsequent accountable owner assignment was located in the reviewed authoritative records. No owner is appointed by this review.
residuals.impactOnRuntimeAcceptance: Laboratory hash matches cannot establish managed-production supply-chain readiness or waive prerequisite enforcement; dependent promotion and final runtime sufficiency remain unaccepted.
requiredClosureEvidence: Traceable accountable owner assignment and defined applicable milestone
Actual applicable hosted-control enforcement and approved artifact/image provenance evidence
Verified digest binding, vulnerability-policy execution/enforcement and independent scoped review against the intended release inputs
residuals.requiredAuthorityDecision: Competent supply-chain/security/release authorities must approve applicable controls and ownership at their milestones; independent TAO/authority determines runtime acceptance. This review neither performs promotion nor accepts supply-chain risk.
residuals.reviewDisposition: PRESERVED — NO CLOSURE, DOWNGRADE, WAIVER OR REDEFINITION

residuals.originalDefinition:
Actual offline continuation requires a separately approved operation-specific policy
and all applicable technical/operational approvals and controls. No offline fallback,
bypass or continuation authorization is created. Design-scope closure does not close
TI-14's partial obligation.
residuals.sourceTableRemainingObligation: Not fully satisfied or accepted; OF-006 / condition 10 remains DESIGN PARTIAL.
residuals.relatedResidual: GS-05 — MEDIUM — Offline continuation and freshness; ACTUAL OFFLINE CONTINUATION EXCLUDED — PROHIBITION PRESERVED
residuals.applicableEvidenceBoundary: Outage denial, no fallback and incomplete-state handling demonstrate refusal under the scoped laboratories, not permission to continue from retained local state.
residuals.remainingGap: No independently/competently approved operation-specific continuation policy was located. OF-006 conditions 1–9 have supporting online/recovery evidence only; condition 10 remains MISSING.
requiredDependency: Separately approved operation/category-specific policy identifying allowed scope, authority, state provenance and previously authorized operations
Approved freshness/expiry, clock uncertainty/restart/unreliable-time, revocation exposure/distribution and no-expiry-extension semantics
Applicable technical/operational/security decisions and evidence before any continuation is permitted
residuals.ownerEvidence: No accountable continuation-policy/residual owner assignment was located. TAO/authority decision responsibility and proposed OD roles are not an implementation-owner assignment.
residuals.impactOnRuntimeAcceptance: No offline continuation, offline fallback, fabricated local authority or executable DURABLE_DEFER is permitted by existing laboratory success. Final runtime acceptance remains PENDING; the missing policy is not NOT_APPLICABLE.
requiredClosureEvidence: Traceable authoritative operation-specific policy and applicable approvals, with exact permitted operations and denied cases
Evidence for authentic retained state, semantic placement authority, destination trust, anti-rollback, validity and known-revocation precedence under that policy
Policy-specific adverse clock/restart/outage/reconnect/recovery and zero-prohibited-effect evidence after separate execution authorization, never inferred from online refusal
residuals.requiredAuthorityDecision: Independent TAO/competent architecture/security/operations authority must explicitly disposition the operation-specific policy and supporting controls before continuation. No policy, exception, execution authorization or runtime acceptance is issued here.
residuals.reviewDisposition: PRESERVED — OFFLINE PROHIBITED; NO CLOSURE, DOWNGRADE, WAIVER OR REDEFINITION
